_example: EXAMPLE CONFIG — copy this, do not run it. Owner Report DOCX build configuration for build_drds_docx.py. Merged over the script's embedded style defaults at run time. If this file is missing or malformed while loaded implicitly, the build falls back to defaults; if it was named explicitly with --config, the build aborts instead. The renderer holds no path defaults, so the four path keys below must be real before the build will run.
_paths: REPLACE ALL FOUR. 'root' is an absolute path; the other three are relative to it. The renderer reads source_md and writes out_docx — it never writes back to the Markdown. Point out_docx at a NEW filename per version; never overwrite an approved baseline.
_page: A4 is the DRDS default. Letter is a US-only override and must be deliberate. The first three rehearsal exports shipped at Letter by accident, because python-docx defaults to it when nothing sets page size.
_palette: Navy headings, charcoal body, muted gold accents, warm off-white callouts, muted red for internal-only blocks. Shared across every document in a package so they read as one deliverable.
_type: Cambria and Calibri chosen for guaranteed availability with Office, not for brand fit. A brand typeface would need embedding or it will substitute on another machine.
_behaviour: source_comments: full | compact | off. render_internal_markers MUST stay true until a recorded client-ready decision; the script refuses to build with it false while the source still declares itself a rehearsal draft.
_page_breaks: PER-DOCUMENT EDITORIAL DATA — DO NOT COPY THIS LIST TO ANOTHER DOCUMENT TYPE. The principle is what carries over, not the prefixes: diagnostic sections break, supporting sections flow. In the validated Owner Report shape, sections 1-5 carry the diagnosis and each starts a new page; sections 6 (Next steps), 7 (Scope) and 8 (Evidence) are supporting and flow, because the navy heading and gold rule already separate them. Adopted after a measured experiment: 11 pages to 9, average page fill 55% to 66%, earlier pages unchanged. A document with different section numbering or different load-bearing sections needs its own list, decided the same way. An exempted heading gets the identical heading treatment, page break aside — no extra spacing above.
_pagination: Short tables are kept whole; callout panels never split. Both defects were found only after conversion, never in Markdown.
_cosmetic: Shared cover policy. Source comments are build metadata, not internal safety markers: they are suppressed on the cover so the page opens on the logo. The rehearsal boundary, placeholders and brackets always render. Blank-header tables are label/value tables and must not shade a data row.
